summary: Re-verify. All gates re-run GREEN after the fix-forward. Web vitest 2550/2550 (+15 new: 11 formula-injection/guard tests in ra-grant-trail, 3 badge tests + 1 sibling in screen-rights). tsc 0. anti-case-lock PASS (baseline 16). ux-g7 self-test PASS. The new tests HONESTLY capture the OWASP tradeoff (they assert +/- leading values get the apostrophe, not hide it). One non-blocking observation: ux-g7 now emits 2 INFORMATIONAL findings (exit 0, does not block) on the reformatted grant-trail stub — a line-local false positive introduced by splitting that honest button across lines.

ux_g7_real_diff.note: 2 line-local false positives on the reformatted grant-trail stub (aria-disabled and onClick now on separate lines from the title= reason). Exit 0 — does not block. See TEST-N1.

adversarial_probe.tool: executed the shipped neutralizeFormula+csvEscape against 14 vectors
adversarial_probe.result: ALL 14 held inert (=, DDE-via-;, +cmd, @, leading TAB, leading CR, leading space, nbsp, fullwidth homoglyph, already-apostrophe, second-line-of-multiline; plus legit mid-= not false-flagged). Quoting intact on the multiline case. See T-0652.review.json reverify_attacks.

tradeoff_honesty.finding: The legitimate-data cost of prefixing (phone '+7..' → '\'+7..', negative '-5' → '\'-5') is asserted openly: csvEscape('-2+3') expects "'-2+3" and csvEscape('+cmd|/c calc') expects "'+cmd|/c calc". The tests document the apostrophe on +/- leading values rather than masking it.

non_blocking.finding: The fix reformatted the grant-trail empty-export <Button> from single-line to multi-line, so aria-disabled="true" and onClick={(e)=>e.preventDefault()} now sit on their own lines while the title= visible reason moved to a separate line. ux-g7 is line-local, so it now flags those two added lines as inert-control-no-visible-reason (2 findings). The button IS honest (visible title + chs-trail__stubhint span). Gate is INFORMATIONAL → exit 0, DOES NOT BLOCK. Ironic that the task's own gate now flags the task's own honest button. Follow-up: either keep the inert marker + a reason marker on the same line, or widen the gate's heuristic window.
Still true: a describedby button line + chs-sr-only reason on a SEPARATE line is not flagged. Line-local heuristic limitation, documented, informational. Not introduced by this task's real changes.
